title: The Real Reason Small Goals Boost Your Motivation

narration.text: Your brain rewards even tiny successes with a powerful surge of dopamine.
This chemical messenger creates feelings of pleasure and satisfaction.
When you achieve a small goal, your brain gets a dopamine hit.
This positive feedback loop encourages you to keep going.
It builds momentum, making larger tasks feel less daunting.
Breaking down big projects into tiny steps can completely change your progress.
What tiny goal are you going to achieve today?

description: Discover why setting small, achievable goals is a powerful strategy for increasing motivation and productivity. Learn about the brain's reward system and how it influences your drive.
topic: Why setting small, achievable goals can increase motivation.
